raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

On gfx950, aiter MLA decode skips the standalone RoPE and runs RoPE, the q/k concat and the KV-cache write in one `fused_qk_rope_cat_and_cache_mla` kernel. On gfx1250 with the triton backend none of that is fused: native RoPE, two `torch.cat` and `set_kv_buffer` are more than a dozen elementwise kernels per layer.

## Modifications

- `_fuse_rope_for_gfx1250_triton_mla()`: with `SGLANG_USE_AITER=1` on gfx1250, triton-backend decode takes the same fused branch as gfx95 aiter MLA. Limited to plain `RotaryEmbedding` / `DeepseekScalingRotaryEmbedding` whose rotary dim and cos/sin table cover the whole rope head, without DSA or DCP.
- sglang's rope keeps cos and sin in one `cos_sin_cache`; on this path the kernel gets the two halves as views. gfx95 keeps aiter's rope module (`cos_cache` / `sin_cache`), which does not build on gfx1250.
- The fused kernel emits a bf16 q for the triton backend, which takes bf16 q whatever the KV-cache dtype.
- `_skip_rope_for_aiter_fused_mla()` is unchanged; gfx95 behaviour is unchanged.

A CPU unit test (`test/registered/unit/models/test_rocm_mla_gfx1250_fused_rope_gate.py`) pins down each term of the gate and the cos/sin order of the tables.

### Dependency on aiter

Requires ROCm/aiter#5501, which the ROCm Docker images carry since #44379 (aiter 2bb549102). Before it, the gfx1250 Gluon launch of `fused_qk_rope_cat_and_cache_mla` passes an extra `MAX_EMBD_POS` argument and fails.

## Setup

Kimi-K2-Thinking-MXFP4, TP8, MI455X (gfx1250), image `rocm/sgl-dev:v0.5.21-rocm10-mi45x-20261011`; aiter is the image's plus ROCm/aiter#5935, #5501, #5043 and #5402 (all in aiter 2bb549102). The image's sglang predates #43735, so the measured build reads the DCP state through `get_parallel().dcp_enabled` instead of `self.dcp_size`. The Kimi-K2 cookbook targets MI300X; flags used here beyond it: `--attention-backend aiter --prefill-attention-backend aiter --decode-attention-backend triton --page-size 64 --disable-radix-cache --disable-custom-all-reduce --chunked-prefill-size 8192 --cuda-graph-max-bs-decode 128`, with `SGLANG_USE_AITER=1`, `SGLANG_ROCM_FUSED_DECODE_MLA=0` and `AITER_FORCE_A8W4=1`. Before and after differ only by this PR.

## Accuracy Tests

GSM8K with `few_shot_gsm8k` (8-shot, 1319 questions, `max_new_tokens` 512, the settings of sglang's AMD Kimi accuracy tests): before and after to be added.

The fused kernel matches the unfused path (q, the written KV rows, untouched rows) for bf16 and fp8 KV, batch 1 to 128.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

RoPE + concat + KV write per layer, Kimi-K2 TP8 shapes, MI455X, CUDA-graph replay:

| batch | unfused (us) | fused (us) |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | 37.6 | 1.9 |
| 4 | 40.8 | 1.6 |
| 32 | 55.6 | 1.7 |
| 128 | 81.6 | 1.9 |

End to end, TP8 8k/1k concurrency 4: TPOT before and after to be added.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed). (to be added)
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

## Review and Merge Process

1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process).
2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers.
3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so.
   - Common commands include `/tag-and-rerun-ci`, `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci`
4. After green CI and required approvals, ask Merge Oncalls or people with Write permission to merge the PR.

@@ -0,0 +1,112 @@
+"""The gate that sends gfx1250 triton MLA decode through the fused rope kernel.
+
+fused_qk_rope_cat_and_cache_mla rotates the whole rope head with one cos/sin
+table and writes the KV cache itself. Where any term below fails, the unfused
+path applies something the kernel does not (a partial rotary dim, a DSA or DCP
+layout, prefill), and the fused result would be wrong without an error.
+"""
+
+import unittest
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+from unittest import mock
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.srt.layers.rotary_embedding.base import RotaryEmbedding
+from sglang.srt.models.deepseek_common.attention_forward_methods import (
+    forward_mla_rocm,
+)
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=5, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+_GATE = forward_mla_rocm.DeepseekMLARocmForwardMixin._fuse_rope_for_gfx1250_triton_mla
+_ROPE_HEAD_DIM = 64
+
+
+def _rope(rotary_dim=_ROPE_HEAD_DIM):
+    with mock.patch("sglang.srt.layers.rotary_embedding.base._is_cpu", True):
+        return RotaryEmbedding(
+            head_size=_ROPE_HEAD_DIM,
+            rotary_dim=rotary_dim,
+            max_position_embeddings=32,
+            base=10000,
+            is_neox_style=False,
+            dtype=torch.float32,
+        )
+
+
+def _attn(**overrides):
+    """An attention module every term accepts, before the caller breaks one."""
+    attn = SimpleNamespace(
+        current_attention_backend="triton",
+        use_dsa=False,
+        dcp_size=1,
+        rotary_emb=_rope(),
+        qk_rope_head_dim=_ROPE_HEAD_DIM,
+    )
+    for k, v in overrides.items():
+        setattr(attn, k, v)
+    return attn
+
+
+def _batch(is_decode=True):
+    return SimpleNamespace(forward_mode=SimpleNamespace(is_decode=lambda: is_decode))
+
+
+class TestGfx1250FusedRopeGate(CustomTestCase):
+    def setUp(self):
+        # The first term is the platform and short-circuits everything else;
+        # patch it so the remaining terms are reachable off gfx1250.
+        patcher = mock.patch.object(
+            forward_mla_rocm, "_use_gfx1250_fused_mla_rope", True
+        )
+        patcher.start()
+        self.addCleanup(patcher.stop)
+
+    def test_takes_the_fused_path_when_every_term_holds(self):
+        self.assertTrue(_GATE(_attn(), _batch()))
+
+    def test_off_gfx1250_nothing_else_is_consulted(self):
+        with mock.patch.object(forward_mla_rocm, "_use_gfx1250_fused_mla_rope", False):
+            self.assertFalse(_GATE(_attn(), _batch()))
+
+    def test_prefill_keeps_the_unfused_path(self):
+        self.assertFalse(_GATE(_attn(), _batch(is_decode=False)))
+
+    def test_each_term_alone_turns_it_off(self):
+        # The kernel serves only the triton backend's plain MLA decode: no DSA
+        # indexer layout, no DCP-sharded KV, and a rope to apply.
+        for name, broken in (
+            ("current_attention_backend", "aiter"),
+            ("use_dsa", True),
+            ("dcp_size", 2),
+            ("rotary_emb", None),
+        ):
+            with self.subTest(term=name):
+                self.assertFalse(_GATE(_attn(**{name: broken}), _batch()))
+
+    def test_partial_rotary_dim_keeps_the_unfused_path(self):
+        """The kernel rotates the whole rope head; a module that rotates only
+        part of it would have the rest rotated too."""
+        attn = _attn(rotary_emb=_rope(rotary_dim=_ROPE_HEAD_DIM // 2))
+        self.assertFalse(_GATE(attn, _batch()))
+
+
+class TestGfx1250RopeTables(CustomTestCase):
+    def test_cos_then_sin_halves_of_the_sglang_cache(self):
+        """sglang's cache is [cos | sin] per position; handing the kernel the
+        halves swapped rotates every query and key the wrong way."""
+        rope = _rope()
+        with mock.patch.object(forward_mla_rocm, "_use_gfx1250_fused_mla_rope", True):
+            cos, sin = forward_mla_rocm._rope_cos_sin(rope)
+
+        position = 5
+        inv_freq = rope._compute_inv_freq(rope.base)
+        torch.testing.assert_close(cos[position], (position * inv_freq).cos())
+        torch.testing.assert_close(sin[position], (position * inv_freq).sin())
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
